scope: Positive duration validation for 22 builtin fields; 21 attach-compatible fields proved on four native profiles via CLI/MCP. Actual crossFork handover is not proven by this stage; R4 and overall task 9 remain open.

contract.input: A supplied timeout, pollInterval or within must be a string parsed by time.ParseDuration with a strictly positive result. Zero, negative, empty, malformed, nonstring and overflow are field errors before builtin IO or control. Values are not echoed.
contract.defaults: Omission retains each consumer default. Web blockHalt.within and crossFork.timeout now expose the existing runtime defaults.
contract.precision: Fractional units, compound durations, microseconds, plus sign and full positive int64 nanoseconds retain exact parsed duration.
contract.subscription: Invalid wsCollected timeout closes an existing handle and retains JSON-safe sanitized provenance.
